title: Integration of blood methylation and skin microbiome data for age prediction
desc: Implementation of a late-fusion architecture for chronological-age prediction from blood DNA methylation and skin microbial composition. Includes fitted modality-specific regressors, nested validation, assay-quality analyses, and an assessment of the paired-data requirements for evaluating integration.
heroCaption: Cohort age distributions, repeated sampling, and participant-level validation.
